title: Portfolio
text:
Work
Projects & Portfolio
Engineering, fabrication, data analysis, and community work. A cross-section of what I've built, modeled, and shipped.



Engineering & Fabrication
Built with hands and machines



  
    
      Thermal Engineering
      Two-Stage Evaporative Cooler
    
    
      Designed and built a two-stage evaporative cooling prototype achieving ΔT = 5°F at 60% relative humidity — a meaningful cooling margin under real-world conditions. Fixed budget, built from scratch.
    
    
      Fusion 360
      Thermodynamics
      Prototyping
    
    
      Request Details
    
  

  
    
      Precision Machining
      Non-Sparking Propane Wrench
    
    
      Fabricated a non-sparking propane regulator wrench entirely by hand on a manual mill, holding ±0.003″ tolerance throughout. Material selected for spark-resistance in flammable environments. A study in setup, patience, and measurement.
    
    
      Manual Mill
      Metrology
      Material Selection
    
    
      Request Details
    
  

  
    
      Curriculum Design
      15-Hour Machining Curriculum
    
    
      Designed and implemented a comprehensive 15-hour curriculum covering manual milling, lathe turning, CAD/CAM development in Fusion 360, and CNC milling for the Twin Cities Makers community shop. Created instructional materials, delivered sessions, and iterated based on participant feedback.

Data & Analysis
Models, code, and results



  
    
      Policy & Finance
      Electric Bus Fleet Conversion
    
    
      30-year cost-benefit analysis for a diesel-to-electric school bus fleet conversion for Centennial School District, MN. Built a financial model in Excel using state energy data and co-authored the formal grant proposal submitted to the district.

Approach
How I Shoot



  
    ☀️
    Style
    Natural Light First
    Golden hour, open shade, window light. I work with the environment rather than against it — the world has better lighting than most studios.
  
  
    🎞️
    Philosophy
    Documentary Eye
    The best portraits happen between poses. I keep the camera ready for the unguarded moments — the laugh, the glance away, the quiet exhale.
  
  
    🗺️
    Location
    Portland & Twin Cities
    Based in Portland, OR during the school year — Minneapolis / St. Paul area in summer. Happy to travel for the right session.
  
  
    📬
    Booking
    Let's Work Together
    Portraits, events, headshots, outdoor sessions. Reach out by email and we'll sort out the details — no complicated booking forms, no surprise fees.

title: Tyler Celotta
text:
Physics student at Reed College in a 3/2 dual degree program — BA Physics at Reed, BS Mechanical Engineering at Columbia. I build things in the shop, model things in code, photograph people and places, and spend too much time outdoors.


About
What I Do



Engineering
Fabricator & Analyst
Physics and mechanical engineering coursework backed by real shop hours — CNC milling, manual milling, welding, CAD/CAM, and precision metrology. I hold tolerances and take measurement seriously.


Data & Code
Python & R Analyst
Mathematical modeling, graphical analysis, and data pipelines in Python and R. I've applied these tools to physics lab work, a national math modeling competition, and cost-benefit modeling for public infrastructure proposals.


Photography
Portrait Photographer
Operating as Celotta Photos since 2023. Documentary-influenced eye, natural light, authentic moments. Based in Portland during the school year, Twin Cities in summer.


Community
Eagle Scout & Leader
Eagle Scout (BSA, 2023). Led a 22-person river rafting Odyssey trip as a certified Wilderness First Responder. Active in public awareness work and community service.

Co-drafted a grant proposal for a diesel-to-electric school bus fleet conversion. Executed a 30-year cost-benefit analysis using Minnesota state energy data and Excel financial modeling.
